a:r.a:t: Let me summarize why Rift matters.
You get dramatically faster CI pipelines - 20 to 250 times faster mock responses, depending on the complexity of your predicates.
You pay zero migration cost. Your existing Mimeo and Solo configurations work unchanged. One Docker image swap.
Developers spend less time waiting for test suites. That's better productivity and better morale.
You get new capabilities: built-in fault injection for chaos engineering, Prometheus metrics for observability.
The bottom line: same configs, same API, dramatically faster. It's a pure improvement with no downside risk.
